item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Soft potato gnocchi tossed in a rich cream sauce with sun-dried tomatoes, spinach and garlic. Gratinated with golden, melted mozzarella and parmesan. (1+2+6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Sri Lankan coconut dal palak, a creamy lentil and spinach curry cooked in coconut milk, seasoned with Sri Lankan spices, mustard seeds and fresh herbs. Served with steamed basmati rice, traditional Sri Lankan flatbread (pol roti) and a range of fresh, spiced sides. (1+11)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Pasta penne alla Norma, a Sicilian pasta dish with fried aubergine in spicy tomato sauce, topped with parmesan and breadcrumbs. (1+6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: GREEN DISH: gobi, a lovely and mild Indian vegetarian dish with cauliflower and potatoes, served with rice. (13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Vegetable chow mein topped with a fried egg and spring onion. Served with Chinese smashed cucumber salad and spicy ketchup. (1+2+7+15)
